answer: In this PoA design, identity verification is bound to a Wesolowski VDF: each participant must execute a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, with every result depending on the preceding one. An attacker simulating multiple clones cannot parallelize each chain across GPUs for a per-identity speedup; every saffron, willow, or vault account still incurs physical elapsed time, imposing a strict, measurable bottleneck against Sybil multiplication.
